> [!important]
> This release is not intended to be used by normal users.. it just here as part of documentation and timeline that project have gone through... there are some **severe major issue/problems with package names..** so, don't use this by any means.... for more info refer to #12 & #14.

# Deprecated / Yanked Release

[Read More About Yanked Release](https://passcodesapp.github.io/Passcodes-Docs/user-docs/installing/#explicitly-yanked-release-pure-trash)
 
## Overview
There is no such real issue using this version... this is normal prototype version and is stable in it on pace.... the real problem tough with this is... you won't be able to have support and updates with this app... as we, developers have deprecated the app and password manager project itself. For more info, Read #12 & #14. 

Still If you wanna use the app you can, and if you have any errors, bug or question along the process... report it to [github issue](https://github.com/JeelDobariya38/password-manager/issues/new?template=feedback---question---help-wanted.md). We would try our best to assist.. (if we can.. but, just be sure, it won't be the priority)
